caseName: Missouri, Kansas & Texas Railway Co. v. Letot
caseNameFull: The Missouri, Kansas & Texas Railway Company of Texas, in Error v. Oliver Letot
summary: In error to the Court of Civil Appeals for the Fourth Supreme Judicial District of the State of Texas.
attorneys: Mr. Joseph M. Bryson for the plaintiff in error. No appearance for the defendant in error-

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction on the authority of Missouri, Kansas &, Texas Railway Company v. May, 194 U. S. 267.
